spec: 2026 Minimum Elements for a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), v2.1 (2026-07-29), published by CISA, the NSA and the FBI with fifteen international partners including Germany's BSI, Japan's METI and Korea's KISA. Replaces the NTIA minimum elements of 2021.
note: Declarative map of the 2026 SBOM minimum elements — 17 data fields and 6 practices — to CycloneDX checks, read by services/registry_conformance.py. Element shapes follow services/g7_registry.json's note: 'cdxPath' is a jq boolean over the whole SBOM, 'missingPath' is a jq expression over $subjects returning the names of subjects MISSING the element, and an element with neither has no automated source and is surfaced as human review. The jq is kept for diffing against upstream; TRUSCA executes the Python ports in services/cisa_conformance.py. Subjects here are the target component plus every enumerated component, which is what the guidance measures its data fields over — not the machine-learning-model subset the G7 registry uses. Every element is advisory (no 'required' key, so the spec default of false applies). The baseline itself draws no such line, but promoting a field would fail an SBOM for a value it may legitimately not have: the guidance accepts an explicit statement that a value is unknown in place of the value, and what is worth reading is how much of each field the scan actually established, which the coverage checks already report. Five of the six practices describe how an organisation operates rather than what a document contains; they carry no automated source. The exceptions are machine-processable data, which format detection has already established, and explicitly identifying unknown information, which a document-level statement can satisfy.

elements.label: SBOM author
elements.cdxPath: ((.metadata.authors // []) | length > 0) or ((.metadata.supplier // null) != null) or ((.metadata.manufacturer // null) != null)

elements.label: SBOM tool name
elements.cdxPath: [ (if ((.metadata.tools // null) | type) == "array" then (.metadata.tools // [])[] else ((.metadata.tools.components // []) + (.metadata.tools.services // []))[] end) | select((.name // "") != "") ] | length > 0

elements.label: SBOM tool version
elements.cdxPath: [ (if ((.metadata.tools // null) | type) == "array" then (.metadata.tools // [])[] else ((.metadata.tools.components // []) + (.metadata.tools.services // []))[] end) ] as $t | ($t | length > 0) and ([ $t[] | select((.version // "") == "") ] | length == 0)

elements.label: Component producer
elements.missingPath: [ $subjects[] | select((((.authors // []) | length) == 0) and ((.publisher // "") == "") and (((.supplier // {}) | length) == 0) and (((.manufacturer // {}) | length) == 0)) | (.name // "(unnamed)") ]

elements.label: Component hash algorithm
elements.missingPath: [ $subjects[] | select(((.hashes // []) | length) > 0) | select((([ (.hashes // [])[] | select(((.alg // "") | ascii_downcase) | test("^(md5|sha-?1|sha-?(224|256|384|512)|sha3-(256|384|512)|blake2b-(256|384|512)|blake3)$")) ] | length) != ((.hashes // []) | length))) | (.name // "(unnamed)") ]

elements.label: Accommodation of updates to SBOM data
